𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝟯 - 𝗔𝘇𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻

Q1. You are ingesting 500 GB/day from on-prem to ADLS Gen2. How will you orchestrate this using ADF and Databricks?
Q2. How to handle backpressure and retry in Azure Data Factory?

𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝟰 - 𝗦𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻
𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻 𝗮 𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗟𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗵𝗼𝘂𝘀𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗰𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺𝗲𝗿 𝘁𝗿𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗮𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀

Q1. How would you manage audit logging for data pipeline activities?
Q2. What metadata strategy would you apply using Unity Catalog?

𝗥𝗼𝘂𝗻𝗱 𝟱 - 𝗛𝗶𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗿 + 𝗖𝘂𝗹𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗲 𝗙𝗶𝘁

Q1. Have you mentored junior engineers? How do you do code reviews? Scenario You are asked to justify infra cost on Azure Databricks to management — how would you explain?
